items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I didn't play with George Lewis.

ctx.x: He's very sick now in California. Yeah, yeah. And I saw him last year.
And Lewis, well a lot of the boys are dead that I know played. There's a gang of them that died. One guy died just last week here, what's his name? Simeon.
